# Tech&Res: copy of vanilla 1.15.0 political_movements/00_ideological_movements.txt - GENERATED by .claude/skills/ztr_politics/scripts/ztrpol_gen_vanilla_overrides.py
# #T&R lines also accept the ideologies that replace the vanilla one (see ztrpol_vanilla_triggers.txt)

REPLACE:movement_socialist = {
	category = movement_category_ideological

	active_law_radicalism_multiplier = 0.75

	ideology = ideology_socialist_movement
	character_ideologies = {
		ideology_communist_leader
		ideology_anarchist
		ideology_state_socialist
		ideology_vanguardist
		ideology_democratic_socialist #T&R
	}

	creation_trigger = {
		has_technology_researched = socialism
		country_has_laws_in_need_of_critical_modernization = no
		ig:ig_trade_unions ?= {
			is_marginal = no # Not counts-as-marginal
		}
	}
	creation_weight = {
		value = 100
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= { # If a movement of this type exists in a neighbouring country, make it more likely to spawn here as well
					any_neighbouring_state = {
						owner = {
							prestige > ROOT.owner.prestige
							any_political_movement = {
								is_political_movement_type = movement_socialist
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
			}
		}
	}
	on_created = {
		add_movement_enthusiasm_modifier = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				had_reformist_socialism_victory = yes
			}
			set_core_ideology = ideology_state_socialist_movement
			remove_character_ideology = ideology_communist_leader
			remove_character_ideology = ideology_anarchist
			remove_character_ideology = ideology_vanguardist
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				had_revolutionary_socialism_victory = yes
			}
			set_core_ideology = ideology_revolutionary_socialist_movement
			remove_character_ideology = ideology_state_socialist
		}
	}

	disband_trigger = {
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_technology_researched = socialism }
			AND = {
				has_council_republic_law = yes
				had_reformist_socialism_victory = yes
			}
		}
	}
	on_disbanded = {
		fold_movement_into_anti_communist_movement_effect = yes
	}

	character_support_trigger = {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				had_reformist_socialism_victory = no
				OR = {
					OR = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist_leader has_ideology = ideology:ideology_stalinist has_ideology = ideology:ideology_maoist has_ideology = ideology:ideology_reform_communist } #T&R
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
					OR = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist has_ideology = ideology:ideology_stalinist has_ideology = ideology:ideology_maoist } #T&R
				}
			}
			AND = {
				had_revolutionary_socialism_victory = no
				OR = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_state_socialist has_ideology = ideology:ideology_democratic_socialist has_ideology = ideology:ideology_third_way } #T&R
				AND = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
					OR = {
						has_liberal_ideology = yes
						has_progressive_ideology = yes
					}
				}
			}
			AND = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_humanitarian
			}
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_utopian
		}
	}
	character_support_weight = {
		value = 200
		if = { # Very vulnerable to fragmentation once the more focused movements emerge
			limit = {
				had_reformist_socialism_victory = no
				OR = {
					OR = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist has_ideology = ideology:ideology_stalinist has_ideology = ideology:ideology_maoist } #T&R
					OR = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist_leader has_ideology = ideology:ideology_stalinist has_ideology = ideology:ideology_maoist has_ideology = ideology:ideology_reform_communist } #T&R
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 5
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				had_reformist_socialism_victory = no
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_anarchist
				NOT = {
					owner ?= {
						any_political_movement = {
							is_political_movement_type = movement_anarchist
						}
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 5
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				had_revolutionary_socialism_victory = no
				OR = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_state_socialist has_ideology = ideology:ideology_democratic_socialist has_ideology = ideology:ideology_third_way } #T&R
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 5
			}
		}
	}

	pop_support_trigger = {
		NOR = {
			is_pop_type = capitalists
			is_pop_type = aristocrats
			is_pop_type = slaves
		}
	}

	pop_support_factors = {
		movement_support_high_urbanization
		movement_support_high_literacy
		movement_support_below_expected_sol
		movement_support_radicalization
		movement_support_academics
		movement_support_laborers
		movement_support_machinists
		movement_support_soldiers_conscripts
	}

	pop_support_weight = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:political_movement
				scope:political_movement ?= {
						OR = {
							is_being_suppressed = yes
							is_being_bolstered = yes
						}
					}
				}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:political_movement = {
						is_being_suppressed = yes
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = suppression_base_value
					multiply = {
						value = -0.5
						add = owner.modifier:country_suppression_attraction_factor
					}
					desc = "concept_suppressed"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = bolstering_base_value
					multiply = {
						value = 0.5
						add = owner.modifier:country_bolster_attraction_factor
					}
					desc = "concept_bolstered"
				}
			}
		}
		add = {
			desc = "URBAN_STATE"
			value = 10
			multiply = state.state_urbanization_rate
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				strata = middle
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					had_reformist_socialism_victory = yes
				}
				multiply = {
					value = 0.5
					desc = "MIDDLE_NO_ICON"
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_pop_type = academics
					}
					add = {
						value = 10
						desc = "POP_ACADEMICS"
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_pop_type = bureaucrats
					}
					add = {
						value = 5
						desc = "POP_BUREAUCRATS"
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_pop_type = shopkeepers
					}
					add = {
						value = 5
						desc = "POP_SHOPKEEPERS"
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				multiply = {
					value = 0.1
					desc = "MIDDLE_NO_ICON"
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_pop_type = academics
					}
					add = {
						value = 3
						desc = "POP_ACADEMICS"
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				strata = lower
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = laborers
				}
				add = {
					value = 18
					desc = "POP_LABORERS"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = machinists
				}
				add = {
					value = 24
					desc = "POP_MACHINISTS"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = 6
					desc = "LOWER_NO_ICON"
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					AND = {
						is_pop_type = soldiers
						pop_employment_building = building_conscription_center
					}
				}
				multiply = {
					value = 1.5
					desc = "CONSCRIPTS"
				}
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				standard_of_living < state.average_expected_sol
				strata = lower
			}
			add = { # Increases likelihood of support if impoverished
				desc = "IS_BELOW_EXPECTED_SOL"
				value = state.average_expected_sol
				subtract = standard_of_living
				max = 10
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						NOR = {
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
						}
					}
				}
				multiply = 2.0
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic
					}
				}
				standard_of_living > state.average_expected_sol
				strata = lower
			}
			add = { # Decreases likelihood of support if well-off
				desc = "IS_ABOVE_EXPECTED_SOL"
				value = state.average_expected_sol
				subtract = standard_of_living
			}
		}

		multiply = { # Illiterate pops participate at 1/10 the rate of fully literate pops
			desc = "POP_LITERACY"
			value = literacy_rate
			add = 0.10
		}

		multiply = { # Multiplied by 1.5x max
			desc = "POP_RADICALS"
			value = pop_radical_fraction
			divide = 2
			add = 1
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					had_reformist_socialism_victory = yes
				}
				owner = {
					at_war_with_council_republic = yes
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "AT_WAR_WITH_COUNCIL_REPUBLIC"
				value = 0.75
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				had_reformist_socialism_victory = no
				owner = {
					has_council_republic_law = yes
				}
				OR = {
					is_pop_type = laborers
					is_pop_type = machinists
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "COUNCIL_REPUBLIC_LAW"
				value = 1.5
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				had_reformist_socialism_victory = no
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_communal_administration
				}
				OR = {
					is_pop_type = clerks
					is_pop_type = bureaucrats
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "COMMUNAL_ADMINISTRATION_LAW"
				value = 1.5
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				had_reformist_socialism_victory = no
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_revolutionary_guard
				}
				OR = {
					is_pop_type = soldiers
					is_pop_type = officers
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "REVOLUTIONARY_GUARD_LAW"
				value = 1.5
			}
		}
	}

	revolution = {
		possible = {
			political_movement_support >= 0.05
		}

		weight = {
			value = 100
		}

		state_weight = {
			value = state_urbanization_rate
			add = scope:clout
			add = { value = this.turmoil divide = 2 }
			subtract = this.loyalists

			if = {
				limit = { is_capital = yes }
				if = {
					limit = { owner ?= { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic } }
					add = 10.0
				}
				else = {
					multiply = 0.1
				}
			}
		}
	}

	secession = {
		possible = {
			political_movement_support >= 0.05
			scope:clout <= 0
		}

		weight = {
			value = 1000
		}

		state_weight = {
			value = state_urbanization_rate
			add = { value = this.turmoil divide = 2 }
			subtract = this.loyalists

			if = {
				limit = { is_capital = yes }
				if = {
					limit = { owner ?= { has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic } }
					multiply = 10.0
				}
				#else = {
				#	multiply = 0.1
				#}
			}
		}
	}

	additional_radicalism_factors = {
		add = movement_radicalism_lack_of_suffrage
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_core_ideology = ideology:ideology_revolutionary_socialist_movement
					had_revolutionary_socialism_victory = yes
				}
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = { has_institution = institution_workplace_safety }
					add = {
						value = 3
						subtract = "institution_investment_level(institution_workplace_safety)"
						multiply = 0.05
						desc = "INSTITUTION_FUNDING_LEVEL_workplace_safety"
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						ig:ig_trade_unions ?= {
							law_enactment_stance = {
								law = law_type:law_worker_protections
								value > neutral
							}
						}
					}
					add = {
						value = 0.1
						desc = "NO_INSTITUTION_workplace_safety"
					}
				}
			}

			if = { # Support translates 1:1 to Activism
				limit = {
					owner = {
						NAND = {
							has_law = law_type:law_council_republic
							has_law = law_type:law_factory_councils
						}
						any_political_movement = {
							is_political_movement_type = movement_socialist
						}
					}
				}
				add = {
					desc = "SOCIALIST_MOVEMENT_REVOLUTIONARISM"
					value = this.political_movement_support
					max = 0.5
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = { has_institution = institution_social_security }

					add = {
						value = 3
						subtract = "institution_investment_level(institution_social_security)"
						multiply = 0.05
						desc = "INSTITUTION_FUNDING_LEVEL_social_security"
					}
				}
				else = {
					add = {
						value = 0.1
						desc = "NO_INSTITUTION_social_security"
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = { has_institution = institution_workplace_safety }
					add = {
						value = 3
						subtract = "institution_investment_level(institution_workplace_safety)"
						multiply = 0.05
						desc = "INSTITUTION_FUNDING_LEVEL_workplace_safety"
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						ig:ig_trade_unions ?= {
							law_enactment_stance = {
								law = law_type:law_worker_protections
								value > neutral
							}
						}
					}
					add = {
						value = 0.1
						desc = "NO_INSTITUTION_workplace_safety"
					}
				}
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				neighboring_country_has_insurrectionary_movement_trigger = { TYPE = movement_socialist }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "NEIGHBOURING_COUNTRY_WITH_REVOLUTION"
				value = 0.15
			}
		}

		add = movement_radicalism_suppressed_after_civil_war

		if = {
			limit = {
				NOR = {
					has_core_ideology = ideology:ideology_state_socialist_movement
					had_reformist_socialism_victory = yes
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner ?= {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_factory_councils
						country_is_abolishing_factory_councils = yes
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = 0.25
					desc = "FACTORY_COUNCILS_BEING_ABOLISHED"
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					owner ?= {
						at_war_with_revolutionary_council_republic = yes
					}
				}
				add = {
					desc = "AT_WAR_WITH_REVOLUTIONARY_COUNCIL_REPUBLIC"
					value = 0.25
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

REPLACE:movement_communist = {
	category = movement_category_ideological

	active_law_radicalism_multiplier = 0.75

	ideology = ideology_communist_movement
	character_ideologies = {
		ideology_communist_leader
		ideology_vanguardist
		ideology_stalinist #T&R
		ideology_maoist #T&R
	}

	creation_trigger = {
		has_technology_researched = socialism
		global_var:reform_or_revolution_conclusion ?= flag:reform
		country_has_laws_in_need_of_critical_modernization = no
		ig:ig_trade_unions ?= {
			is_marginal = no # Not counts-as-marginal
		}
	}
	creation_weight = {
		value = 100
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= { # If a movement of this type exists in a neighbouring country, make it more likely to spawn here as well
					any_neighbouring_state = {
						owner = {
							prestige > ROOT.owner.prestige
							any_political_movement = {
								is_political_movement_type = movement_communist
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
			}
		}
	}
	on_created = {
		add_movement_enthusiasm_modifier = yes
	}
	disband_trigger = {
		OR = {
			NOT = {
				has_technology_researched = socialism
			}
			NOT = {
				global_var:reform_or_revolution_conclusion ?= flag:reform
			}
		}
	}
	on_disbanded = {}

	character_support_trigger = {
		OR = {
			OR = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist has_ideology = ideology:ideology_stalinist has_ideology = ideology:ideology_maoist } #T&R
			OR = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist_leader has_ideology = ideology:ideology_stalinist has_ideology = ideology:ideology_maoist has_ideology = ideology:ideology_reform_communist } #T&R
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_utopian
			AND = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_humanitarian
			}
		}
	}
	character_support_weight = {
		value = 200
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					OR = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_communist_leader has_ideology = ideology:ideology_stalinist has_ideology = ideology:ideology_maoist has_ideology = ideology:ideology_reform_communist } #T&R
					OR = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_vanguardist has_ideology = ideology:ideology_stalinist has_ideology = ideology:ideology_maoist } #T&R
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 5
			}
		}
	}

	pop_support_trigger = {
		NOR = {
			is_pop_type = capitalists
			is_pop_type = aristocrats
			is_pop_type = slaves
		}
	}

	pop_support_factors = {
		movement_support_high_urbanization
		movement_support_high_literacy
		movement_support_below_expected_sol
		movement_support_radicalization
		movement_support_academics
		movement_support_laborers
		movement_support_machinists
		movement_support_soldiers_conscripts
	}

	pop_support_weight = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:political_movement
				scope:political_movement ?= {
						OR = {
							is_being_suppressed = yes
							is_being_bolstered = yes
						}
					}
				}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:political_movement = {
						is_being_suppressed = yes
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = suppression_base_value
					multiply = {
						value = -0.5
						add = owner.modifier:country_suppression_attraction_factor
					}
					desc = "concept_suppressed"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = bolstering_base_value
					multiply = {
						value = 0.5
						add = owner.modifier:country_bolster_attraction_factor
					}
					desc = "concept_bolstered"
				}
			}
		}

		add = {
			desc = "URBAN_STATE"
			value = 10
			multiply = state.state_urbanization_rate
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				strata = middle
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.10
				desc = "MIDDLE_NO_ICON"
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = academics
				}
				add = {
					value = 3
					desc = "POP_ACADEMICS"
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				strata = lower
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = laborers
				}
				add = {
					value = 18
					desc = "POP_LABORERS"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = machinists
				}
				add = {
					value = 25
					desc = "POP_MACHINISTS"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = clerks
				}
				add = {
					value = 6
					desc = "POP_CLERKS"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = peasants
				}
				add = {
					value = 3
					desc = "POP_PEASANTS"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = 6
					desc = "LOWER_NO_ICON"
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					AND = {
						is_pop_type = soldiers
						pop_employment_building = building_conscription_center
					}
				}
				multiply = {
					value = 2
					desc = "CONSCRIPTS"
				}
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				standard_of_living < state.average_expected_sol
				strata = lower
			}
			add = { # Increases likelihood of support if impoverished
				desc = "IS_BELOW_EXPECTED_SOL"
				value = state.average_expected_sol
				subtract = standard_of_living
				max = 15
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						NOR = {
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_universal_suffrage
						}
					}
				}
				multiply = 1.5
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						NOR = {
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic
							has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_worker_protections
						}
					}
				}
				multiply = 1.25
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOT = {
						has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_council_republic
					}
				}
				standard_of_living > state.average_expected_sol
				strata = lower
			}
			add = { # Decreases likelihood of support if well-off
				desc = "IS_ABOVE_EXPECTED_SOL"
				value = state.average_expected_sol
				subtract = standard_of_living
			}
		}

		multiply = { # Illiterate pops participate at 1/10 the rate of fully literate pops
			desc = "POP_LITERACY"
			value = literacy_rate
			add = 0.10
		}

		multiply = { # Multiplied by 2x max
			desc = "POP_RADICALS"
			value = pop_radical_fraction
			add = 1
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
					owner = {
						has_law = law_type:law_council_republic
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = { # Multiplied by 2x max
				desc = "POP_LOYALISTS"
				value = 1
				subtract = pop_loyalist_fraction
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					at_war_with_council_republic = yes
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "AT_WAR_WITH_COUNCIL_REPUBLIC"
				value = 0.75
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_council_republic_law = yes
				}
				OR = {
					is_pop_type = laborers
					is_pop_type = machinists
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "COUNCIL_REPUBLIC_LAW"
				value = 1.5
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_communal_administration
				}
				OR = {
					is_pop_type = clerks
					is_pop_type = bureaucrats
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "COMMUNAL_ADMINISTRATION_LAW"
				value = 1.5
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_revolutionary_guard
				}
				OR = {
					is_pop_type = soldiers
					is_pop_type = officers
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "REVOLUTIONARY_GUARD_LAW"
				value = 1.5
			}
		}
	}

	revolution = {
		possible = {
			political_movement_support >= 0.05
		}

		weight = {
			value = 100
		}
	}

	secession = {
		possible = {
			political_movement_support >= 0.05
			scope:clout <= 0
		}

		weight = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}

	additional_radicalism_factors = {
		add = movement_radicalism_lack_of_suffrage
		owner = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_institution = institution_workplace_safety }

				add = {
					value = 3
					subtract = "institution_investment_level(institution_workplace_safety)"
					multiply = 0.05
					desc = "INSTITUTION_FUNDING_LEVEL_workplace_safety"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					ig:ig_trade_unions ?= {
						law_enactment_stance = {
							law = law_type:law_worker_protections
							value > neutral
						}
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = 0.1
					desc = "NO_INSTITUTION_workplace_safety"
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_factory_councils
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						country_is_abolishing_factory_councils = yes
					}

					add = {
						value = 0.25
						desc = "FACTORY_COUNCILS_BEING_ABOLISHED"
					}
				}
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				neighboring_country_has_insurrectionary_movement_trigger = { TYPE = movement_communist }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "NEIGHBOURING_COUNTRY_WITH_REVOLUTION"
				value = 0.15
			}
		}

		if = { # Support translates 1:1 to Activism
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NAND = {
						has_law = law_type:law_council_republic
						has_law = law_type:law_factory_councils
					}
					any_political_movement = {
						is_political_movement_type = movement_communist
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "COMMUNIST_MOVEMENT_REVOLUTIONARISM"
				value = this.political_movement_support
				max = 0.5
			}
		}
		add = movement_radicalism_suppressed_after_civil_war

		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					at_war_with_revolutionary_council_republic = yes
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "AT_WAR_WITH_REVOLUTIONARY_COUNCIL_REPUBLIC"
				value = 0.25
			}
		}
	}
}

REPLACE:movement_fascist = {
	category = movement_category_ideological

	active_law_radicalism_multiplier = 1

	ideology = ideology_fascist_movement
	character_ideologies = {
		ideology_fascist
		ideology_integralist
		ideology_corporatist_leader
		ideology_neofascist #T&R
	}

	disband_trigger = {
		has_council_republic_law = yes
	}
	on_disbanded = {
		fold_movement_into_anti_communist_movement_effect = yes
	}

	creation_trigger = {
		has_technology_researched = political_agitation
		country_should_exclusively_focus_on_modernization = no
	}
	creation_weight = {
		value = 100
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= { # If a movement of this type exists in a neighbouring country, make it more likely to spawn here as well
					any_neighbouring_state = {
						owner = {
							prestige > ROOT.owner.prestige
							any_political_movement = {
								is_political_movement_type = movement_fascist
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
			}
		}
	}
	on_created = {
		add_movement_enthusiasm_modifier = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					any_primary_culture = {
						has_discrimination_trait = language_lusophone
					}
				}
			}
			set_core_ideology = ideology_integralist_movement
		}
	}

	character_support_trigger = {
		OR = {
			OR = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist has_ideology = ideology:ideology_neofascist } #T&R
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_integralist
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_corporatist_leader
			OR = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_ethno_nationalist has_ideology = ideology:ideology_national_populist } #T&R
		}
	}
	character_support_weight = {
		value = 200
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					OR = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist has_ideology = ideology:ideology_neofascist } #T&R
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_integralist
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 5
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_corporatist_leader
					OR = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_ethno_nationalist has_ideology = ideology:ideology_national_populist } #T&R
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
			}
		}
	}

	pop_support_trigger = {
		NOT = {
			is_pop_type = slaves
		}
	}

	pop_support_factors = {
		movement_support_high_literacy
		movement_support_middle_below_expected_sol
		movement_support_radicalization
		movement_support_unemployed
		movement_support_capitalists
		movement_support_aristocrats
		movement_support_shopkeepers
		movement_support_officers
		movement_support_farmers
		movement_support_clerks
		movement_support_soldiers
		movement_support_number_of_claims
	}

	pop_support_weight = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:political_movement
				scope:political_movement ?= {
						OR = {
							is_being_suppressed = yes
							is_being_bolstered = yes
						}
					}
				}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:political_movement = {
						is_being_suppressed = yes
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = suppression_base_value
					multiply = {
						value = -0.5
						add = owner.modifier:country_suppression_attraction_factor
					}
					desc = "concept_suppressed"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = bolstering_base_value
					multiply = {
						value = 0.5
						add = owner.modifier:country_bolster_attraction_factor
					}
					desc = "concept_bolstered"
				}
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				strata = upper
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = capitalists
				}
				add = {
					value = 12
					desc = "POP_CAPITALISTS"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = aristocrats
				}
				add = {
					value = 5
					desc = "POP_ARISTOCRATS" # Fascism is too populist
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = 5
					desc = "UPPER_NO_ICON"
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					owner ?= {
						any_political_movement = {
							OR = {
								is_political_movement_type = movement_socialist
								is_political_movement_type = movement_anarchist
								is_political_movement_type = movement_communist
								is_political_movement_type = movement_labor
								is_political_movement_type = movement_nihilist
							}
							political_movement_support >= 0.05
						}
					}
				}
				multiply = {
					desc = "STRONG_SOCIALIST_MOVEMENT"
					value = 1.5
					owner ?= {
						every_political_movement = {
							limit = {
								OR = {
									is_political_movement_type = movement_socialist
									is_political_movement_type = movement_anarchist
									is_political_movement_type = movement_communist
									is_political_movement_type = movement_labor
									is_political_movement_type = movement_nihilist
								}
							}
							add = this.political_movement_radicalism
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						number_of_claims > 0
					}
				}

				add = {
					value = culture.culture_current_fervor # Add a base value for having claims at all
					divide = 100 # Culture is 1-100
					multiply = {
						value = owner.number_of_claims
					}
					max = 10
					desc = "NUMBER_OF_CLAIMS"
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				strata = middle
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = shopkeepers
				}
				add = {
					value = 15
					desc = "POP_SHOPKEEPERS"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = bureaucrats
				}
				add = {
					value = 8
					desc = "POP_BUREAUCRATS"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = officers
				}
				add = {
					value = 8
					desc = "POP_OFFICERS"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = farmers
				}
				add = {
					value = 5
					desc = "POP_FARMERS"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = 4
					desc = "MIDDLE_NO_ICON"
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					owner ?= {
						any_political_movement = {
							OR = {
								is_political_movement_type = movement_socialist
								is_political_movement_type = movement_anarchist
								is_political_movement_type = movement_communist
								is_political_movement_type = movement_labor
								is_political_movement_type = movement_nihilist
							}
							political_movement_support >= 0.05
						}
					}
				}
				multiply = {
					desc = "STRONG_SOCIALIST_MOVEMENT"
					value = 1
					owner ?= {
						every_political_movement = {
							limit = {
								OR = {
									is_political_movement_type = movement_socialist
									is_political_movement_type = movement_anarchist
									is_political_movement_type = movement_communist
									is_political_movement_type = movement_labor
									is_political_movement_type = movement_nihilist
								}
							}
							add = this.political_movement_radicalism
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner = {
						number_of_claims > 0
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = culture.culture_current_fervor # Add a base value for having claims at all
					divide = 100 # Culture is 1-100
					multiply = {
						value = owner.number_of_claims
					}
					max = 10
					desc = "NUMBER_OF_CLAIMS"
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				strata = lower
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = clerks
				}
				add = {
					value = 5
					desc = "POP_CLERKS"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = soldiers
				}
				add = {
					value = 3
					desc = "POP_SOLDIERS"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = 2
					desc = "LOWER_NO_ICON"
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						is_pop_type = clerks
						is_pop_type = soldiers
					}
					owner = {
						number_of_claims > 0
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = culture.culture_current_fervor # Add a base value for having claims at all
					divide = 125 # Culture is 1-100
					multiply = {
						value = owner.number_of_claims
					}
					max = 5
					desc = "NUMBER_OF_CLAIMS"
				}
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				standard_of_living < state.average_expected_sol
				OR = {
					strata = middle
					strata = upper
				}
			}
			add = { # Increases likelihood of support if impoverished
				desc = "IS_BELOW_EXPECTED_SOL"
				value = state.average_expected_sol
				subtract = standard_of_living
				max = 10
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				standard_of_living > state.average_expected_sol
				OR = {
					strata = middle
					strata = upper
				}
			}
			add = { # Decreases likelihood of support if well-off
				desc = "IS_ABOVE_EXPECTED_SOL"
				value = state.average_expected_sol
				subtract = standard_of_living
				min = -5
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				is_employed = no
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 1.5
				desc = "UNEMPLOYED"
			}
		}

		multiply = { # Illiterate pops participate at 1/10 the rate of fully literate pops
			desc = "POP_LITERACY"
			value = literacy_rate
			add = 0.10
		}

		multiply = {
			value = 0.011
			multiply = pop_acceptance
			desc = "ACCEPTANCE"
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					strata = upper
					strata = middle
					is_pop_type = clerks
				}
			}
			multiply = { # Multiplied by 2x max
				desc = "POP_RADICALS"
				value = pop_radical_fraction
				multiply = 2
				add = 1
			}
		}
		else = {
			multiply = { # Multiplied by 1.5x max
				desc = "POP_RADICALS"
				value = pop_radical_fraction
				divide = 2
				add = 1
			}
		}
	}

	revolution = {
		possible = {
			political_movement_support >= 0.05
		}

		weight = {
			value = 100
		}

		state_weight = {
			value = 0.25
			add = scope:clout
			add = { value = this.turmoil divide = 2 }
			subtract = this.loyalists
		}
	}

	secession = {
		possible = {
			political_movement_support >= 0.05
			scope:clout <= 0
		}

		weight = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}

	additional_radicalism_factors = {
		owner = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner.number_of_claims > 0
				}

				add = {
					value = 5 # Add a base value for having claims at all
					add = owner.number_of_claims
					multiply = 0.025
					max = 0.3
					desc = "NUMBER_OF_CLAIMS"
				}
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				neighboring_country_has_insurrectionary_movement_trigger = { TYPE = movement_fascist }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "NEIGHBOURING_COUNTRY_WITH_REVOLUTION"
				value = 0.15
			}
		}

		if = { # Support translates 1:1 to Activism
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NAND = {
						has_law = law_type:law_single_party_state
						ruler.interest_group.party ?= {
							is_party_type = fascist_party
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "FASCIST_MOVEMENT_WILL_TO_POWER"
				add = this.political_movement_support
				max = 0.5
			}
		}
		add = movement_radicalism_suppressed_after_civil_war
	}
}

REPLACE:movement_corporatist = {
	category = movement_category_ideological

	ideology = ideology_corporatist_movement
	character_ideologies = {
		ideology_corporatist_leader
		ideology_developmentalist #T&R
	}

	disband_trigger = {
		has_council_republic_law = yes
	}
	on_disbanded = {
		fold_movement_into_anti_communist_movement_effect = yes
	}

	creation_trigger = {
		has_technology_researched = corporatism
		country_should_exclusively_focus_on_modernization = no
	}
	creation_weight = {
		value = 100
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= { # If a movement of this type exists in a neighbouring country, make it more likely to spawn here as well
					any_neighbouring_state = {
						owner = {
							prestige > ROOT.owner.prestige
							any_political_movement = {
								is_political_movement_type = movement_corporatist
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
			}
		}
	}
	on_created = {
		add_movement_enthusiasm_modifier = yes
	}

	character_support_trigger = {
		OR = {
			is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_corporatist_leader
			OR = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist has_ideology = ideology:ideology_neofascist } #T&R
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_integralist
			OR = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_state_socialist has_ideology = ideology:ideology_democratic_socialist has_ideology = ideology:ideology_third_way } #T&R
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_utopian
		}
	}
	character_support_weight = {
		value = 200
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_corporatist_leader
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 5
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					OR = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_fascist has_ideology = ideology:ideology_neofascist } #T&R
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_integralist
				}
				NOT = {
					owner ?= {
						any_political_movement = {
							is_political_movement_type = movement_fascist
						}
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 3
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				is_interest_group_type = ig_devout
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
			}
		}
	}

	pop_support_trigger = {
		NOT = {
			is_pop_type = slaves
		}
	}

	pop_support_factors = {
		movement_support_high_literacy
		movement_support_aristocrats
		movement_support_clergymen
		movement_support_shopkeepers
		movement_support_clerks
		movement_support_peasants
	}

	pop_support_weight = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:political_movement
				scope:political_movement ?= {
						OR = {
							is_being_suppressed = yes
							is_being_bolstered = yes
						}
					}
				}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:political_movement = {
						is_being_suppressed = yes
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = suppression_base_value
					multiply = {
						value = -0.5
						add = owner.modifier:country_suppression_attraction_factor
					}
					desc = "concept_suppressed"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = bolstering_base_value
					multiply = {
						value = 0.5
						add = owner.modifier:country_bolster_attraction_factor
					}
					desc = "concept_bolstered"
				}
			}
		}
		add = {
			value = 1
			desc = "POP_BASE_SUPPORT"
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				strata = upper
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = aristocrats
				}
				add = {
					value = 18
					desc = "POP_ARISTOCRATS"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = 6
					desc = "UPPER_NO_ICON"
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					owner ?= {
						any_political_movement = {
							OR = {
								is_political_movement_type = movement_socialist
								is_political_movement_type = movement_anarchist
								is_political_movement_type = movement_communist
							}
							political_movement_support >= 0.10 # (chuckles) im in danger
						}
					}
				}
				multiply = {
					value = 1.5
					desc = "STRONG_SOCIALIST_MOVEMENT"
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				strata = middle
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = clergymen
				}
				add = {
					value = 25
					desc = "POP_CLERGYMEN"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = farmers
				}
				add = {
					value = 15
					desc = "POP_FARMERS"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = officers
				}
				add = {
					value = 12
					desc = "POP_SHOPKEEPERS"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = shopkeepers
				}
				add = {
					value = 10
					desc = "POP_SHOPKEEPERS"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = 9
					desc = "MIDDLE_NO_ICON"
				}
			}

			if = {
				limit = {
					owner ?= {
						any_political_movement = {
							OR = {
								is_political_movement_type = movement_socialist
								is_political_movement_type = movement_anarchist
								is_political_movement_type = movement_communist
							}
							political_movement_support >= 0.10
						}
					}
				}
				multiply = {
					value = 1.25
					desc = "STRONG_SOCIALIST_MOVEMENT"
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				strata = lower
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = soldiers
				}
				add = {
					value = 6
					desc = "POP_CLERKS"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = peasants
				}
				add = {
					value = 15
					desc = "POP_PEASANTS"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = 3
					desc = "LOWER_NO_ICON"
				}
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				standard_of_living < state.average_expected_sol
				strata = middle
			}
			add = { # Increases likelihood of support if impoverished
				desc = "IS_BELOW_EXPECTED_SOL"
				value = state.average_expected_sol
				subtract = standard_of_living
				max = 10
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				standard_of_living > state.average_expected_sol
				strata = middle
			}
			add = { # Decreases likelihood of support if well-off
				desc = "IS_ABOVE_EXPECTED_SOL"
				value = state.average_expected_sol
				subtract = standard_of_living
				min = -5
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				is_employed = no
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 1.5
				desc = "UNEMPLOYED"
			}
		}

		multiply = { # Illiterate pops participate at 1/10 the rate of fully literate pops
			desc = "POP_LITERACY"
			value = literacy_rate
			add = 0.10
		}

		multiply = { # Intentional that this is different from fascism
			value = 0.01
			multiply = pop_acceptance
			add = 0.20
			desc = "ACCEPTANCE"
		}
	}

	revolution = {
		possible = {
			political_movement_support >= 0.05
		}

		weight = {
			value = 100
		}

		state_weight = {
			value = 0.25
			add = scope:clout
			add = { value = this.turmoil divide = 2 }
			subtract = this.loyalists
		}
	}

	secession = {
		possible = {
			political_movement_support >= 0.05
			scope:clout <= 0
		}

		weight = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}

	additional_radicalism_factors = {
		add = movement_radicalism_schools_funding

		if = {
			limit = {
				neighboring_country_has_insurrectionary_movement_trigger = { TYPE = movement_corporatist }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "NEIGHBOURING_COUNTRY_WITH_REVOLUTION"
				value = 0.15
			}
		}
		add = movement_radicalism_suppressed_after_civil_war
	}
}

REPLACE:movement_liberal = {
	category = movement_category_ideological

	ideology = ideology_liberal_movement
	character_ideologies = {
		ideology_market_liberal
		ideology_liberal_leader
		ideology_republican_leader
		ideology_radical
		ideology_humanitarian
		ideology_third_way #T&R
		ideology_market_reformer #T&R
	}

	disband_trigger = {
		has_council_republic_law = yes
	}
	on_disbanded = {
		fold_movement_into_anti_communist_movement_effect = yes
	}

	creation_trigger = {
		has_technology_researched = democracy
		country_should_exclusively_focus_on_modernization = no
	}
	creation_weight = {
		value = 100
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_law = law_type:law_monarchy
				country_has_voting_franchise = no
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.1
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= { # If a movement of this type exists in a neighbouring country, make it more likely to spawn here as well
					any_neighbouring_state = {
						owner = {
							prestige > ROOT.owner.prestige
							any_political_movement = {
								is_political_movement_type = movement_liberal
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				c:JAP ?= this
				has_law = law_type:law_bakufu
				country_has_pending_meiji_restoration = yes
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.01
			}
		}
	}
	on_created = {
		add_movement_enthusiasm_modifier = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					c:FRA ?= this
				}
			}
			set_core_ideology = ideology_liberal_republican_movement
		}
	}

	character_support_trigger = {
		OR = {
			OR = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_market_liberal has_ideology = ideology:ideology_neoliberal has_ideology = ideology:ideology_tech_libertarian has_ideology = ideology:ideology_libertarian } #T&R
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_liberal_leader
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_republican_leader
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_humanitarian
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_humanitarian_royalist
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_reformer
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_utopian
			has_ideology = ideology:ideology_modernizer_leader
			OR = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_positivist has_ideology = ideology:ideology_technocrat } #T&R
		scope:interest_group ?= {
		OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_liberal
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_universalist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_liberal_modern
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_universalist_modern
				}
			}
		}
	}
	character_support_weight = {
		value = 200
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_republican_leader
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_liberal_leader
					OR = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_market_liberal has_ideology = ideology:ideology_neoliberal has_ideology = ideology:ideology_tech_libertarian has_ideology = ideology:ideology_libertarian } #T&R
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 5
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
				NOT = {
					owner ?= {
						any_political_movement = {
							is_political_movement_type = movement_radical
						}
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 5
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_humanitarian
				NOT = {
					is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 5
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_modernizer_leader
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
			}
		}
		if = { # Liberal agitators just inherently love liberalism
			limit = {
				scope:interest_group ?= {
					OR = {
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_liberal
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_universalist
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_liberal_modern
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_universalist_modern
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
			}
		}
	}

	pop_support_trigger = {
		NOT = {
			is_pop_type = slaves
		}
	}

	pop_support_factors = {
		movement_support_je_hungarian_revolution
		movement_support_high_urbanization
		movement_support_high_literacy
		movement_support_capitalists
		movement_support_aristocrats
		movement_support_shopkeepers
		movement_support_academics
		movement_support_bureaucrats
		movement_support_clerks
	}

	pop_support_weight = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:political_movement

							is_being_bolstered = yes

					}

				limit = {

				}

			else = {

						value = 0.5
						add = owner.modifier:country_bolster_attraction_factor
					}
					desc = "concept_bolstered"
				}
			}
		}

			value = 3
			desc = "POP_BASE_SUPPORT"
		}

			desc = "URBAN_STATE"
			value = 10
			multiply = state.state_urbanization_rate
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				strata = upper
			}

				limit = {
					is_pop_type = capitalists
				}
				add = {
					value = 50
					desc = "POP_CAPITALISTS"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = aristocrats
				}

						}
					}
					add = {
						value = 25
						desc = "je_hungarian_revolution"
					}
				}
				else = {
				add = {
					value = 6
					desc = "POP_ARISTOCRATS"
				}
			}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = 9
					desc = "UPPER_NO_ICON"
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				strata = middle
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = shopkeepers
				}
				add = {
					value = 20
					desc = "POP_SHOPKEEPERS"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = academics
				}
				add = {
					value = 35
					desc = "POP_ACADEMICS"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = bureaucrats
				}
				add = {
					value = 15
					desc = "POP_BUREAUCRATS"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = 13
					desc = "MIDDLE_NO_ICON"
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				strata = lower
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = clerks
				}
				add = {
					value = 9
					desc = "POP_CLERKS"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = peasants
				}
				add = {
					value = 0
					desc = "POP_PEASANTS"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = 3
					desc = "LOWER_NO_ICON"
				}
			}
		}

		multiply = { # Illiterate pops participate at 1/10 the rate of fully literate pops
			desc = "POP_LITERACY"
			value = literacy_rate
			add = 0.10
		}
	}

	revolution = {
		possible = {
			political_movement_support >= 0.05
		}

		weight = {
			value = 100
		}

		state_weight = {
			value = state_urbanization_rate
			#add = scope:clout
			add = { value = this.turmoil divide = 2 }
			subtract = this.loyalists
		}
	}

	secession = {
		possible = {
			political_movement_support >= 0.05
			scope:clout <= 0
		}

		weight = {
			value = 1000
		}

		state_weight = {
			value = state_urbanization_rate
			add = { value = this.turmoil divide = 2 }
			subtract = this.loyalists
		}
	}

	additional_radicalism_factors = {
		add = movement_radicalism_lack_of_suffrage
		add = movement_radicalism_schools_funding
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= { has_journal_entry = je_devorismo }
			}
			add = {
				value = 0.2
				desc = "je_devorismo"
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					country_has_voting_franchise = yes
					electoral_confidence < 0.9
				}
			}
			add = {
				value = 1
				subtract = owner.electoral_confidence
				divide = 5
				multiply = {
					value = 1
					add = owner.modifier:country_electoral_confidence_impact_mult
				}
				desc = "low_electoral_confidence"
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				neighboring_country_has_insurrectionary_movement_trigger = { TYPE = movement_liberal }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "NEIGHBOURING_COUNTRY_WITH_REVOLUTION"
				value = 0.15
			}
		}

			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = soldiers
				}
				add = {
					value = 15
					desc = "POP_SOLDIERS"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = 3
					desc = "LOWER_NO_ICON"
				}
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					has_variable = positivist_leaders_increase_var
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = officers
				}
				multiply = {
					value = 1.25
					desc = "POSITIVISM_BONUS"
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = soldiers
				}
				add = {
					value = 1.10
					desc = "POSITIVISM_BONUS"
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					has_variable = positivist_leaders_large_increase_var
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = officers
				}
				multiply = {
					value = 1.5
					desc = "POSITIVISM_BONUS"
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = soldiers
				}
				add = {
					value = 1.25
					desc = "POSITIVISM_BONUS"
				}
			}
		}

		multiply = { # Illiterate pops participate at 1/10 the rate of fully literate pops
			desc = "POP_LITERACY"
			value = literacy_rate
			add = 0.10
		}
	}

	revolution = {
		possible = {
			political_movement_support >= 0.05
		}

		weight = {
			value = 100
		}

		state_weight = {
			value = 0.25
			add = scope:clout
			add = { value = this.turmoil divide = 2 }
			subtract = this.loyalists
		}
	}

	secession = {
		possible = {
			political_movement_support >= 0.05
			scope:clout <= 0
		}

		weight = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}

	additional_radicalism_factors = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				neighboring_country_has_insurrectionary_movement_trigger = { TYPE = movement_positivist }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "NEIGHBOURING_COUNTRY_WITH_REVOLUTION"
				value = 0.15
			}
		}
		add = movement_radicalism_suppressed_after_civil_war
	}
}

REPLACE:movement_reactionary = {
	category = movement_category_ideological

	ideology = ideology_reactionary_movement
	character_ideologies = {
		ideology_traditionalist
		ideology_protectionist
		ideology_authoritarian
		ideology_luddite
		ideology_military_junta #T&R
		ideology_national_populist #T&R
		ideology_neoconservative #T&R
	}

	creation_trigger = {
		country_should_exclusively_focus_on_modernization = no
		has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_slavery_banned
		country_has_voting_franchise = yes
		NOT = { # Reactionary and Legitimist movements cannot co-exist
			any_political_movement = {
				OR = {
					is_political_movement_type = movement_legitimist
					is_political_movement_type = movement_carlist
					is_political_movement_type = movement_miguelist
				}
			}
		}
	}
	creation_weight = {
		value = 100
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner ?= { # If a movement of this type exists in a neighbouring country, make it more likely to spawn here as well
					any_neighbouring_state = {
						owner = {
							prestige > ROOT.owner.prestige
							any_political_movement = {
								is_political_movement_type = movement_reactionary
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
			}
		}
	}
	on_created = {
		add_movement_enthusiasm_modifier = yes
	}

	disband_trigger = {
		OR = {
			any_political_movement = {
				OR = {
					is_political_movement_type = movement_legitimist
					is_political_movement_type = movement_carlist
					is_political_movement_type = movement_miguelist
				}
			}
			has_council_republic_law = yes
		}
	}
	on_disbanded = {
		fold_movement_into_anti_communist_movement_effect = yes
	}

	character_support_trigger = {
			OR = {
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_traditionalist
				OR = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_protectionist has_ideology = ideology:ideology_developmentalist } #T&R
				OR = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_authoritarian has_ideology = ideology:ideology_military_junta } #T&R
				has_ideology = ideology:ideology_luddite
				OR = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_jingoist_leader has_ideology = ideology:ideology_national_populist } #T&R
				scope:interest_group ?= {
					OR = {
						ztrpol_is_reactionary_ig = yes #T&R
						has_patriarchal_ideology = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
	character_support_weight = {
		value = 200
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					OR = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_protectionist has_ideology = ideology:ideology_developmentalist } #T&R
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_traditionalist
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_luddite
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 5
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				AND = {
					OR = { has_ideology = ideology:ideology_authoritarian has_ideology = ideology:ideology_military_junta } #T&R
					scope:interest_group ?= {
						OR = {
							is_interest_group_type = ig_intelligentsia
							is_interest_group_type = ig_trade_unions
						}
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:interest_group ?= {
					OR = {
						ztrpol_is_reactionary_ig = yes #T&R
						has_patriarchal_ideology = yes
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 2
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				AND = {
					has_ideology = ideology:ideology_reformer
					scope:interest_group ?= {
						ztrpol_is_reactionary_ig = yes #T&R
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				value = 0.10
			}
		}
	}

	pop_support_trigger = {
		NOT = {
			is_pop_type = slaves
		}
	}

	pop_support_factors = {
		movement_support_high_literacy
		movement_support_aristocrats
		movement_support_clergymen
		movement_support_shopkeepers
		movement_support_farmers
		movement_support_clerks
		movement_support_laborers
		movement_support_soldiers
		movement_support_peasants
	}

	pop_support_weight = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:political_movement
				scope:political_movement ?= {
						OR = {
							is_being_suppressed = yes
							is_being_bolstered = yes
						}
					}
				}
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:political_movement = {
						is_being_suppressed = yes
					}
				}
				add = {
					value = suppression_base_value
					multiply = {
						value = -0.5
						add = owner.modifier:country_suppression_attraction_factor
					}
					desc = "concept_suppressed"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = bolstering_base_value
					multiply = {
						value = 0.5
						add = owner.modifier:country_bolster_attraction_factor
					}
					desc = "concept_bolstered"
				}
			}
		}

		add = {
			value = 1
			desc = "POP_BASE_SUPPORT"
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				strata = upper
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = aristocrats
				}
				add = {
					value = 15
					desc = "POP_ARISTOCRATS"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = 6
					desc = "UPPER_NO_ICON"
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				strata = middle
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = clergymen
				}
				add = {
					value = 15
					desc = "POP_CLERGYMEN"
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = shopkeepers
				}
				add = {
					value = 12
					desc = "POP_SHOPKEEPERS"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = farmers
				}
				add = {
					value = 20
					desc = "POP_FARMERS"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = 9
					desc = "MIDDLE_NO_ICON"
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				strata = lower
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = clerks
				}
				add = {
					value = 10
					desc = "POP_CLERKS"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = laborers
				}
				add = {
					value = -3
					desc = "POP_LABORERS"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = soldiers
				}
				add = {
					value = 10
					desc = "POP_SOLDIERS"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					is_pop_type = peasants
				}
				add = {
					value = 12
					desc = "POP_PEASANTS"
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					value = 3
					desc = "LOWER_NO_ICON"
				}
			}
		}

		multiply = { # Illiterate pops participate at 1/10 the rate of fully literate pops
			desc = "POP_LITERACY"
			value = literacy_rate
			add = 0.10
		}

		multiply = {
			value = 0.012
			multiply = pop_acceptance
			desc = "ACCEPTANCE"
		}

		if = { # If a more radical movement exists, it'll poach radicals from this one.
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					any_political_movement = {
						is_political_movement_type = movement_fascist
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "POP_RADICAL_MOVEMENT_LOSSES"
				value = 1
				subtract = pop_radical_fraction
			}
		}
	}

	revolution = {
		possible = {
			political_movement_support >= 0.05
		}

		weight = {
			value = 100
		}

		state_weight = {
			value = 0.5
			add = scope:clout
		}
	}

	secession = {
		possible = {
			political_movement_support >= 0.05
			scope:clout <= 0
		}

		weight = {
			value = 1000
		}
	}

	additional_radicalism_factors = {
		owner ?= {
			add = {
				value = country_turmoil
				multiply = 0.5
				desc = "COUNTRY_TURMOIL"
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_journal_entry = je_russian_revolution
				}
				add = {
					desc = "russian_revolution_radicalism"
					value = 0.15
				}
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				neighboring_country_has_insurrectionary_movement_trigger = { TYPE = movement_reactionary }
			}
			add = {
				desc = "NEIGHBOURING_COUNTRY_WITH_REVOLUTION"
				value = 0.15
			}
		}
		add = movement_radicalism_suppressed_after_civil_war
	}
}
